description: Synthetic Ascent defensive setups for the validation harness (sim-batch). Each setup places the 5 defenders on real PV-4 navgraph zones with forward holds, mid control and crossfires — not all stacked on sites — so the simulator faces a realistic defense instead of a 5v2 walk-in. The Match Runner selects one per round by seed (see `selection`). Grounded in PV-1's tactical KB (datasets/derived/tactics/ascent-tactics.json) defensive elements and the PV-4 navgraph zone ids; illustrative, NOT real match-frequency data.

selection.note: Per round, pick setups[i] where i is chosen from a seed-derived value weighted by `weight` (equal weights → round-robin by seed). Deterministic per match seed + roundId.

abilityCatalog.note: abilityId values must exist in the sim's ability catalog (manual-approx). Current ids: omen:Ability2 (smoke), sova:Ability2 (recon dart), brimstone:Ability1 (incendiary). The Match Runner should apply these only when it runs rounds with utility enabled (withAbilities).

notes: Basis: PV-1 datasets/derived/tactics/ascent-tactics.json (defensive elements) + PV-4 datasets/spatial/ascent/ascent.navgraph.json (zone ids, read-only).
Illustrative pro-style setups, not a measured distribution. Utility placement follows each source tactic's utilityRequirements where the sim catalog supports it.

setups.name: Standard 2-1-2 (default)
setups.rationale: Two forward site anchors (A Main, B Main) + one mid controller + two site anchors. The baseline balanced hold; attackers meet resistance at entries instead of a vacant site.

setups.name: A Stack 3-1-1
setups.rationale: Stacks A with a site anchor, A Main forward and an A Tree crossfire; one mid controller; a lone B sentinel-style anchor. Punishes an A execute hard, concedes a fast B take.

setups.name: Mid Control 2-2-1
setups.rationale: Contests mid with two players (Courtyard + Catwalk) to deny the split and gain info, a default A hold, and a lone B anchor. Tests the value of mid control against attacker executes.
